name: Consistencia de Temperatura de Color
description: Analiza local color temperature variations para detectar composited regions with mismatched balance de blancos.
algorithm: Regional Color Temperature Estimation and Consistency Check
mechanism: Estimates local color temperature (Kelvin) a través de image patches mediante el análisis de the ratio of warm to cool spectral components. Spliced or generado por IA regions may exhibit inconsistent values.
parameters: Estimation: Planckian locus fitting, Patches: 32×32, Color space: CIE xy, Temperature range: 2000-10000K
source: Hsu, Y.F. & Chang, S.F. (2010) — Image Splicing Detection Using Camera Response Function Consistency, IEEE ICME
useCase: Detecting composited regions by identifying mismatched balance de blancos settings

references.title: Hsu, Y.F. & Chang, S.F. (2010) — Image Splicing Detection Using Camera Response Function Consistency, IEEE ICME

strengths:
• Physics-based color análisis
• Detecta balance de blancos mismatches
• Complementary to illuminant map
• Works a través de different scenes
limitations:
• Assumes consistent ambient lighting
• Mixed lighting complicates análisis
• Color temperature varies naturally
• Sensitive to noise in dark regions
